title: tpu-pallas Result
description: Output payload of the tpu-pallas agent: a kernel commit on the gap's branch, on the requested stack head, with its verdict against the incumbent, or why there is none. The full report stays on disk in `final_report`.

status.description: 'patched': a candidate was committed, measured and apply-checked on the stack head. 'at_floor': the baseline is within the gate of its floor and the fusion prize is under noise, so no kernel is warranted; tpu-critical-review's stop review agreed. 'invalid_input': the request cannot be run as given; every gap is in `missing`. 'blocked': the fix lies outside the vllm_torchtpu plugin, no slot could be claimed, or the kernel cannot be lowered after the stop review's continuation. 'failed': infrastructure failed past the relaunch limit, or the apply check exited 4 (`base mismatch`: the ref's base is not the image's plugin commit). Every slot claimed is released before any of them is returned.

summary.description: Verdict and per-phase speedup in one line.

verdict.description: Against the verbatim incumbent, whole-call, per phase, on the stack head. 'win': faster above noise in some phase, no phase regressed, tpu-critical-review passed. 'tie': within noise. 'loss': slower in a phase. 'invalid': the oracle or tpu-critical-review rejected the claim.

plugin.description: The kernel: the gap's branch and the commit tpu-code-stack made of tpu-pallas's kernel on it, `patch` its `git diff base..sha` (final/kernel_patch.diff).

ref.description: The branch or tag measured, e.g. `stack`, `hyp/2-moe-gate`.

sha.description: The commit `ref` named when it was measured.

patch.description: `git diff base..sha` as plugin_source.py diff wrote it: the one patch the job applies, kept so the arm replays without the repo.

applies_to.description: The apply check: `plugin.patch` applied on the stack head's image in a compute job, and apply_vllm_patch.sh's exit code for it.

stack_sha.description: The `stack` commit the kernel commit descends from.

exit_code.description: 0 applied. Exit 4 is status `failed` with failure_reason `base mismatch`, never a verdict.

carried.description: Findings that are not kernel changes, each with its owner, including the end-to-end accuracy check a win still owes when it was not run here.

missing.description: What the caller must change, when status is 'invalid_input'.

failure_reason.description: What stopped the campaign, when status is 'blocked' or 'failed'.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.summary: win: decode_last 1.31x, decode_first 1.18x, prefill 1.00x; applies on the stack head.
carried: end-to-end mmlu_pro on the stacked image -> caller (tpu-serving-bench eval)

examples.summary: The relayout the gap needs is in torch_tpu, outside the vllm_torchtpu plugin.
examples.failure_reason: fix outside plugin: the copy is emitted by torch_tpu's lowering of index_select, which no vllm_torchtpu patch reaches.
